domains.name: Flesh
domains.description: Living ships, grown, bred or tamed rather than built. They heal their own wounds, flex around danger and feel what their crew feels.

domains.name: Mind
domains.description: Magical ships, carved with runes, crewed by spellcasters or run by a thinking core. They calculate, conjure and see what others miss.

domains.name: Void
domains.description: Strange ships, made of things that shouldn't exist or touched by the dark between stars. They bend space, drain warmth and feed on dread.

domains.name: Energy
domains.description: Charged ships, with reactors running hot, coils humming and plasma vented on a whim. They zap, burn and overload.

domains.name: Metal
domains.description: Armored ships, all heavy plating, rivets and raw mass. They take a beating, ram through and hold the line.

domains.name: Glass
domains.description: Precise ships, built around lenses, prisms and crystal sensors. They study a target, cut it apart and turn its own light against it.

archetypes.name: Leviathan
features: While you have any Hope, gain +1 to all system Action Rolls.
While you have no Hope, gain +1 to all system Reaction Rolls.

archetypes.name: Necromancer
features: Once per scene, as a reaction, when a ship within Very Close range becomes **Disabled**, you can **spend a Hope** to clear 1 HP on that ship or on your own ship.
Once per scene, you can **spend a GM Fear** as though it were your own Hope.

archetypes.name: Drake
features: When you damage an enemy within Very Close range, gain a **Power Token**.
Once per spotlight, you can **spend 2 Power Tokens** in place of 1 Hope.

archetypes.name: Champion
features: Once per scene, when you mark a single Hull Point, you can **spend a Hope** instead.
When an ally within Very Close range would take damage from a direct attack, you can take that damage instead, as a reaction.

archetypes.name: Direwolf
features: Once per scene, when your **Studied Target** becomes **Disabled**, gain 3 Hope. Choose a new Studied Target immediately.

archetypes.name: Wraith
features: If you have no **Analysis Tokens**, gain an Analysis Token when the GM spends a Fear to activate an adversary.
Before a ship system roll, you can **discard all Analysis Tokens** to gain a bonus to the roll equal to the number discarded.

archetypes.name: Elemental
features: Once per spotlight, you can convert an **Analysis Token** to a **Power Token**, or a Power Token to an Analysis Token.
Each **Refuel**, choose a damage type. **Spend a Power Token** to gain resistance to that damage type against one instance of damage.

archetypes.name: Golem
features: When you mark any number of HP from an adversary's attack, gain 1 **Analysis Token**.
When you would take damage, you can **discard any number of Analysis Tokens** to reduce the damage by your pilot's tier for each token discarded.

archetypes.name: Alchemist
features: Before you make an Action Roll against your **Studied Target**, you can **spend up to 3 Analysis Tokens**. For each token spent, choose a different benefit: (A) convert the damage type to any damage type; (B) increase the attack's Proficiency by 1; (C) extend the attack's range by one band, to a maximum of Very Far.
When an Action Roll against your Studied Target succeeds with Hope, gain an **Analysis Token**.

archetypes.name: Specter
features: **Spend 3 Power Tokens** to become *transdimensional* until the start of your next spotlight. While transdimensional, you can move through solid objects, take no damage, and cannot cause damage. If you end this state in contact with a physical object, mark 3 HP and a Stress and place your ship adjacent to it.

archetypes.name: Revenant
features: When you mark any number of Hull Points, you can also refill one card's **Reload Tokens**.
Your Proficiency increases by the number of your systems that are **Breached**.

archetypes.name: Lich
features: While you are within Close range of your **Studied Target**, each time the GM spends a Fear to spotlight it, they must also mark an unmarked Stress on it.
Once per **Refuel**, clear Stress equal to the GM's Fear pool.

archetypes.name: Phoenix
features: When you mark any number of HP, gain that many **Power Tokens**.
Once per spotlight, when you would mark HP, **spend 3 Power Tokens** to reduce the number by 1.

archetypes.name: Raiju
features: **Spend 2 Power Tokens** to move a Far distance directly toward your **Studied Target** before making an Action Roll. If this roll deals damage to your target, it also marks a Stress. **With Lock:** up to Very Far instead.
When you move closer to your Studied Target, or it moves closer to you, gain a **Power Token**.

archetypes.name: Hydra
features: If your attack against your **Studied Target** would fail, **mark a Hull Point** to make it succeed with Fear instead.
Once per **Refuel**, when your Studied Target marks Hull Points within Very Close range, clear a number of the Hull Points it marked.

keywords.name: Pilot
keywords.rules: The character flying the ship. Ships have no Hope: features that spend or gain Hope use the pilot's Hope.

keywords.name: Hull Points (HP)
keywords.rules: A ship's Hit Points, tracked per system. When a ship marks HP, the pilot chooses which systems mark them, unless an adversary's feature says otherwise.

keywords.name: Breached
keywords.rules: A system with all its HP marked is **Breached**. Every action using a **Breached** system has disadvantage, whether or not it comes from a domain card.

keywords.name: Disabled
keywords.rules: A ship with every HP marked is **Disabled**. It can't fly, attack or take other ship actions. See Damage.

keywords.name: While Available
keywords.rules: If this card is in your ship's loadout or vault, you gain its passive benefit.

keywords.name: Sense
keywords.rules: A ship can sense another ship within sensor range (Very Far, unless a domain card changes it) that isn't blocked by other ships or danger zones.

keywords.name: Lock / Locked
keywords.rules: See **Locks**. Features marked "**With Lock:**" need their target to be **Locked**.

keywords.name: Studied Target
keywords.rules: A ship a card has made your **Studied Target**. You can have one at a time; a new one replaces the old. It ends when the scene ends.

keywords.name: Analysis Tokens, Power Tokens
keywords.rules: Domain tokens that cards grant and spend. You can hold up to 12 of each.

keywords.name: Reload Tokens
keywords.rules: Some cards hold **Reload Tokens**, up to the number they list. While a card with **Reload Tokens** is available, you can **spend a Hope** or **mark a Stress** to refill one card's **Reload Tokens**.

keywords.name: Scene end
keywords.rules: Conditions, **Clouds**, mines and other effects your ship creates end when the scene ends. Tokens last until spent or until your next **Refuel** or **Refit**.

keywords.name: Contact
keywords.rules: You **make contact** with a ship when you succeed on an attack against it, dock with it, or succeed on a **Transport Action Roll** against it.

keywords.name: Forward Facing
keywords.rules: In a **Chase**, **Forward Facing** features can only affect ships in a band ahead of yours. Outside a **Chase** they can affect any ship.

keywords.name: Aft Facing
keywords.rules: In a **Chase**, **Aft Facing** features can only affect ships in a band behind yours. Outside a **Chase** they can affect any ship.

keywords.name: Observing
keywords.rules: A ship that has left a **Chase**. See Chases.

keywords.name: Cloud
keywords.rules:
An area of space with an effect inside it. Unless a feature says otherwise:
- A **Cloud** is centered on your position when you create it.
- Its radius depends on your ship's size: Melee (size 1), Very Close (size 2), Close (sizes 3 and 4), Far (size 5).
- It stays where you created it. In a **Chase** it keeps its band.
- It dissipates at the start of your next spotlight.
- It has no effect until a feature adds one. Choose which of your features are active when you create it; they don't change until you create a new **Cloud**.

keywords.name: Pd damage
keywords.rules: "Pd8+4" means roll d8s equal to the pilot's Proficiency, then add 4.

keywords.name: Size
keywords.rules:
When ships of different sizes interact:
- The larger ship has disadvantage on attacks against the smaller ship; the smaller ship has advantage on attacks against the larger ship.
- Size also changes the HP a ship marks (see Damage) and limits **Locks** (see **Locks**).

rulesSections.title: Characters and Ships
rulesSections.text: Ships are not creatures. Character domain cards and features usually have no effect in ship scenes; the GM decides exceptions (such as Teleport). Once ships are Docked and creatures Board, character abilities work normally inside and between the ships.

rulesSections.title: Ranges and Moving
rulesSections.text:
- Ship scenes use the usual ranges (Melee, Very Close, Close, Far, Very Far), scaled to space.
- When you make an action roll, your ship can move to a point within Close range as part of it. To move farther, or to move without making an action roll, succeed on a Transport Action Roll.

rulesSections.title: Chase Summary
rulesSections.text:
- **Start:** The lead ship (usually the one leaving) is in front. Roll **Transport** to set starting bands; a better result puts you nearer the front, or, for a PC lead, keeps adversaries further back.
- **Bands:** Rows of ships side by side. A ship 1 band away is at least **Close**, 2 bands away at least **Far**, 3 or more at least **Very Far**.
- **Moving:** Changing 1 band uses your move. To change 2, make a **Transport Action Roll** (disadvantage if any adversary is smaller). Beat all: move 2 bands. Beat some: move 1 band, and an adversary you didn't beat may move 1 band. Beat none: normal move within Close.
- **Adversaries moving:** When one tries to move more than 1 band, the closest PC makes a **Transport Reaction Roll**. Success: it moves 1 band and that PC may move 1 band. Failure: it moves 2 bands.
- **Hazards:** Stationary objects pass through the bands as a column. Every ship in it makes the same reaction roll.
- **Leaving:** Make a **Transport Action Roll** against the highest Difficulty among your pursuers. Success (or no pursuer): you are **Observing**. Failure: you move 1 band forward or back, and your pursuer matches it. A ship at Very Far from every other ship is also Observing.
- **Observing** ships can't be targeted by ships in the Chase and are usually safe from its hazards. At the start of its spotlight, an Observing ship can rejoin at either side of any band.

rulesSections.title: Resting
rulesSections.text:
- **Refuel** (1 day): End any conditions and tokens your ship still has. You can then **mark any of your unmarked Stress** to pay for domain card features (such as refilling **Reload Tokens**). Then clear 1d6 Stress and 1d6 HP, spread across your systems as you choose.
- **Refit** (1 week, at a place that can do the work): As a **Refuel**, but you can **mark as much Stress as you want** to pay for domain card features. Then clear all Stress and HP. If the situation allows it, the GM can let you swap domain cards.

rulesSections.title: Locks
rulesSections.text:
- Make a Science Action Roll against an adversary ship's Difficulty to give it the **Locked** condition. You can only Lock ships your size or larger.
- Once a ship is Locked, any ally can use "With Lock" features against it, whatever their size.
- The party can have one Locked adversary at a time. Locking a new target ends the old Lock. A Lock also ends when no PC ship can sense the target.
- Adversaries can Lock one PC ship at a time.
- **Breaking a Lock:** When an adversary acts to break your party's Lock, the PC ship closest to it makes a Science Reaction Roll against its Difficulty; on a failure, the Lock ends. When a PC ship acts to break a Lock on itself, it makes a Transport Action Roll against the highest Difficulty among adversaries that can sense it. On a success the Lock ends; on a critical success, you can also Lock an adversary you can sense.

rulesSections.title: Attacking
rulesSections.text: An attack is any action meant to deal damage. Weapons cards use Weapons Action Rolls unless they say otherwise.

rulesSections.title: Damage
rulesSections.text:
- Roll damage and compare it to the ship's thresholds to find the HP it marks, as for characters.
- **Size difference:** A ship marks 1 fewer HP for each size it is larger than the attacker, and 1 more for each size it is smaller. This can reduce the HP marked to 0. Damage from a ship's Clouds, mines and other features counts as coming from that ship; hazards have no size.
- **PC ships:** The pilot chooses which systems mark the HP. When every HP is marked the ship is Disabled: the crew is alive but the ship can't be operated. A Disabled ship marks Stress instead of HP. When it marks its last Stress, the pilot and the ship each make a death move, and they must choose different ones.
- **Adversary ships:** Each marked HP gives -1 to the ship's action and reaction rolls, to a maximum of -6. Marking every HP leaves the ship Disabled. Marking every Stress destroys it and kills those inside; cargo is ruined unless specially protected.

rulesSections.title: Docking
rulesSections.text:
- **Docking** joins two ships so that creatures and cargo can cross. Docking with a willing ship needs no roll, unless the GM calls for a Transport Action Roll under pressure.
- **Forced Docking** against an unwilling ship: make a Transport Action Roll with disadvantage against its Difficulty plus its Transport bonus (or a fitting pilot Experience; see Adversary Ships). Against a Disabled ship, roll against its Difficulty with no bonuses; the GM must spend a Fear to add a pilot Experience.
- When an adversary attempts a Forced Docking on your ship, make a Transport Reaction Roll with advantage. On a success the ships don't dock, and the adversary marks 1 HP. On a failure both ships are Docked.
- All touching ships with the Docked condition are docked to each other.
- A Docked ship can't make Transport Action Rolls while docked to a ship of its size or larger.
- When a Docked ship would mark 2 or more HP, it can pass 1 of them to a ship it is docked to.

rulesSections.title: Boarding
rulesSections.text:
- Without a domain card that says otherwise, creatures can only board a Docked ship. Boarding a willing ship needs no roll.
- Boarding an unwilling ship is a scene the GM builds (defenders, locked doors, sealed or vented rooms).

rulesSections.title: Undocking
rulesSections.text:
- Willing ships undock with no roll, unless the GM calls for one.
- A Disabled ship can't undock and can't stop another ship from undocking.
- **Breaking free of a Forced Docking:** Make a Transport Action Roll with disadvantage against the other ship's Difficulty. With Hope, the ships undock. With Fear, choose: undock and mark 1 HP, or stay docked. On a failure you stay docked.
- **An adversary breaking free:** Make a Transport Reaction Roll with advantage. On a success it stays docked. On a failure it undocks, but if your Hope Die is higher than your Fear Die it must mark 1 HP to do so.

rulesSections.title: Adversary Ships
rulesSections.text:
- Adversary ships use the normal adversary stats, plus a **Transport bonus** and a **Weapons bonus**. The GM can add one of these to the ship's Difficulty without spending a Fear.
- Use the ship's Difficulty for ship rolls, not the pilot's. If the pilot has an Experience higher than the relevant bonus, the GM can add it instead, without spending a Fear.
- *Example:* a ship with Difficulty 10 and a Transport bonus of +2 is hit on a 12. If its pilot has *Slippery +3*, the GM can use that instead: the ship is hit on a 13.

rulesSections.title: Chases
rulesSections.text:
A Chase is a special ship scene: every ship is moving the same way toward the same goal. Once any ship tries to leave a scene, any other ship that can fly can start a Chase.

### Starting a Chase
- The **lead ship** is usually the one leaving. Place it near the middle of the table, with room for 3 bands behind it and 2 or 3 ahead.
- **Adversary lead:** Up to two other adversary ships can share its band. Place the rest in the next 3 bands behind it, in whatever order suits the scene; no rolls. Each PC makes a Transport Reaction Roll. Beat every adversary's Difficulty: start in the band just behind the lead. Beat some: start one band further back. Beat none: start in the third band back. Then any PC can move back as many bands as they like.
- **PC lead:** The lead PC makes a Transport Action Roll. Adversaries whose Difficulty is higher than the result can start in any band behind the lead; the rest start 2 bands back. With Hope, the other PCs place their ships in any band behind the lead, after the adversaries. With Fear, the other PCs roll and place as for an adversary lead, before the adversaries.

### During a Chase
- The spotlight moves as in any other scene.
- **Bands** are rows of ships side by side. Within a band, measure range normally. A ship in another band is at least Close away if it is 1 band away, at least Far if 2 bands, and at least Very Far if 3 or more. It can be further, depending on how far it is to the side.
- **Moving:** Changing one band uses your move. To change two bands, make a Transport Action Roll, with disadvantage if any adversary in the Chase is smaller than you. Beat every adversary's Difficulty: move two bands. Beat some: move one band, and one adversary you didn't beat can move one band as a reaction. Beat none: make your normal move within Close range, but you can't move forward a band if an adversary within Close range blocks your advance.
- **Adversaries moving:** When an adversary tries to move more than one band, the closest PC makes a Transport Reaction Roll. On a success, the adversary moves one band and that PC can move one band. On a failure, the adversary moves two bands.
- **Stationary objects** (debris, asteroids) pass through the bands as a column, as wide as the GM decides. Every ship in the column makes the same reaction roll to avoid it.

### Leaving a Chase
- **Dropping out:** Say so on your spotlight. If no adversary pursues, you are Observing. If one does, make a Transport Action Roll against the highest Difficulty among your pursuers; on a success, you are Observing. On a failure, you move one band forward or back, and your pursuer makes the same move.
- **Keeping an adversary in:** When an adversary tries to drop out, one PC can make a Transport Reaction Roll against it. On a failure it is Observing. On a success it moves one band forward or back, and that PC makes the same move.
- **Outpacing:** A ship at Very Far range from every other ship in the Chase is Observing.
- **Observing** ships can't be targeted by ships in the Chase and are usually safe from the Chase's hazards. At the start of its spotlight, an Observing ship can rejoin at either side of any band.

cards.name: Prey Drive
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to add the number of your marked Transport Hull Points to your next Transport Action Roll this spotlight. **While Available:** You have an extra Stress slot.

cards.name: Writhe
cards.rules: While you have any Hope, you have advantage on rolls to make, resist or break free of a **Forced Docking**.

cards.name: Self Repair
cards.rules: Once per **Refuel**, **spend up to 3 Hope** to clear that many Hull Points from one system.

cards.name: Fluid Motion
cards.rules: When you make a Transport Action Roll with Hope, you gain +2 Evasion until the start of your next spotlight.

cards.name: Pod Travel
cards.rules: When you move, you can make a Transport Action Roll against the highest Difficulty among adversaries within Close range. On a success, you, every ally with Pod Travel available, and one other ally can each move to a point within Close range. On a failure, you move alone.

cards.name: Spore Cloud
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to create a **Cloud**. Attacks against targets in your **Cloud** have disadvantage. **Locked** ships in your **Cloud** lose the **Locked** condition.

cards.name: Predictive Pathways
cards.rules: When you **Refuel** or **Refit**, gain 3 **Analysis Tokens**. When another ship moves into Close range of you, you can **spend an Analysis Token** to move up to Close range away from it as a reaction.

cards.name: Blindspot
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to slip into the blindspot of a ship within Very Close range. That ship can't target you while you're in its blindspot. This ends when you choose, when either ship starts a spotlight farther than Very Close from the other, or when you use this card on another ship.

cards.name: Engine Sync
cards.rules: **With Lock:** Add the trait you use for Transport rolls to your Evasion against the **Locked** target's attacks, if it's positive.

cards.name: Calculations Confirmed
cards.rules: Once per scene, when an attack misses you, gain a Hope.

cards.name: Slipstream Transference
cards.rules: When you mark any Hull Points, you can **spend a Hope** to clear a Stress as a reaction. **While Available:** You have an extra Transport Hull Point.

cards.name: Warpfield Strain
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress**. Until the end of this spotlight, each adversary with an unmarked Stress that you fly within Very Close range of marks a Stress.

cards.name: Void Cohesion
cards.rules: While you have 4 or more Void cards in your loadout, you have +2 Evasion.

cards.name: Warp Draw
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to create a **Cloud**. Ships you choose that start their spotlight in your **Cloud** mark a Hull Point if they move.

cards.name: Overdrive
cards.rules: When you succeed on a roll with Hope, you can **mark a Stress** or **spend a Power Token** to move to a point within Close range, even if you've already moved this spotlight.

cards.name: Desperate Charge
cards.rules: Once per spotlight, **mark a Stress** to clear a Transport Hull Point. For the rest of this spotlight, add the number of your marked Stress to your Transport rolls.

cards.name: Power Reroute
cards.rules: When you make a non-Transport Action Roll with Hope, you can gain a **Power Token**. **Spend a Power Token** to gain advantage on a Transport roll.

cards.name: Fleet Transponder
cards.rules: Once per **Refuel**, when an ally within Close range fails a Transport roll with Hope, you can **mark a Stress** to make it a success with Fear instead.

cards.name: Cold Steel
cards.rules: This card holds 2 **Reload Tokens**. When you succeed on a **Forced Docking**, or a ship fails a **Forced Docking** against you, that ship marks a Stress, and you can **spend a Reload Token** to make it mark a Hull Point.

cards.name: Punch Through
cards.rules: You have advantage on Transport Reaction Rolls. When an environment makes you mark Hull Points, mark 1 fewer. **While Available:** You have an extra Transport Hull Point.

cards.name: Faraday Cage
cards.rules: While any of your Transport Hull Points are unmarked, you have resistance to tech damage.

cards.name: Dense Frame
cards.rules: Rolls to move your ship against your will have disadvantage, and you have advantage on rolls to resist them. While you are docked only to ships your size, you can make Transport Action Rolls with disadvantage. **While Available:** You have an extra Transport Hull Point.

cards.name: Sharp Edges
cards.rules: When you break free of a **Forced Docking**, the ship you were docked to marks a Hull Point. Once per scene, when you **make contact** with a ship within Melee range, you can **mark a Stress** to make it mark a Hull Point.

cards.name: Churn Rider
cards.rules: When a larger ship within Very Close range moves, you can **spend a Hope** to move with it as a reaction, to a point within Close range of where you started.

cards.name: Mirage Cloud
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to create a **Cloud**. Ships in your **Cloud** can't be targeted by ships at Far range or farther from them. At the start of your spotlight, you can **spend a Hope** to move your active **Cloud** to your position and keep it from dissipating.

cards.name: Defensive Sync
cards.rules: Once per scene, you can make a ship within Far range your **Studied Target**. You have +1 Evasion against your **Studied Target**'s attacks. When its attack misses you by 1, gain a Hope.

cards.name: Reflective Hull
cards.rules: When you mark a Transport Hull Point while none are marked, you can make a ship within Very Close range mark a Hull Point. **While Available:** You have an extra Transport Hull Point.

cards.name: Spearhead Charge
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Make a Weapons Action Roll against an unobstructed target within Far range. On a success, move into Melee range of it and deal Pd8 physical damage. **With Lock:** Roll with advantage.

cards.name: Flechette Spines
cards.rules: **Spend a Hope** to make a Weapons Action Roll against all targets within Close range. Targets you succeed against take 1 physical damage and mark a Stress. If this **Disables** any ships, gain a Hope.

cards.name: Leeching Strike
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal Pd4+3 physical damage. If it marks any Hull Points, clear a Stress.

cards.name: Engulf
cards.rules: **Spend a Hope** to make a Weapons Action Roll against a target your size or smaller within Close range. On a success, it is temporarily *Engulfed*: it can't make Transport Action Rolls and must target you with all other actions. At the start of each of your spotlights, the *Engulfed* ship takes Pd6 physical damage.

cards.name: Tracer Fire
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal Pd6+4 tech damage, and either **spend an Analysis Token** to **Lock** the target or gain an **Analysis Token**.

cards.name: Breaching Curse
cards.rules: **With Lock:** Make a Weapons Action Roll against the **Locked** target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6 magic damage. **Spend any number of Analysis Tokens** to add a d6 for each one spent.

cards.name: Eldritch Lance
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, choose one: deal Pd6 magic or physical damage, or **mark a Stress** to deal Pd10+6 magic damage. **With Lock:** +4 damage.

cards.name: Spacetime Chasm
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Far range. Once per **Refuel**, on a success, **the GM gains a Fear** and you draw a line from the target to a point within Far range of you and the target. Every ship touching the line takes Pd8+2 magic damage and marks a Stress.

cards.name: Entropic Beam
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, deal Pd10+4 tech damage. You can also **mark a Stress** to make the target mark a Stress and lower its Difficulty by 1 until the end of the scene.

cards.name: Null Sphere
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** and choose a point within Far range. Make a Weapons Action Roll (15). On a success, every ship within Very Close range of that point takes Pd6+4 magic damage. Each ship that marks 2 or more Hull Points is also temporarily **Restrained**.

cards.name: Blacklight Laser
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal Pd6+4 tech damage. On a roll with Fear, hit or miss, you can **mark a Stress** to **Lock** the target. **With Lock:** On a success, add the GM's current Fear to the damage.

cards.name: Annihilation Beam
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Once per **Refuel**, **spend a Hope** to make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal magic damage: a d8 for each Fear the GM has. **With Lock:** If the target is larger than you, it marks Hull Points as if it were your size.

cards.name: Warp Cascade
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to move to a point within Far range. Then you can make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal Pd10+4 tech damage, and the target is **Restrained** until the end of its next spotlight.

cards.name: Plasma Caster
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll with disadvantage against a target within Far range and against every adversary touching the straight line of your shot. Every ship touching the line marks a Stress. You can **spend a Power Token** to deal 1d6+10 tech damage to each adversary you succeed against. On a success against the target, it also takes Pd6 tech damage as part of the same attack. **With Lock:** Roll without disadvantage.

cards.name: Volley Fire
cards.rules: **Forward Facing. Mark a Stress** or **spend a Power Token** to make a Weapons Action Roll against all targets within Close range. Targets you succeed against take 2d6 tech damage.

cards.name: Erratic Pulse
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, deal Pd8+4 tech damage, and you can **spend a Power Token** to make the target temporarily **Vulnerable**. **With Lock:** You don't need to spend the **Power Token**.

cards.name: Jamming Blast
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, the target is temporarily *Jammed*: it has disadvantage on attack rolls. You can also **spend a Power Token** to deal Pd6 tech damage to it. **With Lock:** Roll with advantage.

cards.name: Fire Gout
cards.rules: **Mark a Hull Point** and gain a **Power Token** to make a Weapons Action Roll against all targets within Melee range. Targets you succeed against take Pd6+4 tech damage and are *Burning* until they use an action to put it out. A *Burning* ship marks a Stress at the end of each of its spotlights.

cards.name: Tether
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal Pd4 tech damage. If it marks any Hull Points, it also marks a Stress and you clear a Stress. **With Lock:** Roll with advantage.

cards.name: Plutonium Railgun
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** This card holds 3 **Reload Tokens**. **Spend 2 Reload Tokens** to make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, deal Pd10+4 physical damage. **With Lock:** Roll with advantage.

cards.name: Gatling Autoturret
cards.rules: This card holds 4 **Reload Tokens**. When an adversary ship enters Very Close range of you, you can **spend a Reload Token** to make a Weapons Reaction Roll against it. On a success, deal Pd4+6 physical damage.

cards.name: Seeking Missile
cards.rules: This card holds 3 **Reload Tokens**. **With Lock: Spend 3 Reload Tokens** to make the target temporarily *Sought*. At the start of each of its spotlights while it is *Sought*, make a Weapons Reaction Roll against it. On a success, deal Pd12 physical damage. *Sought* doesn't end when the **Lock** does.

cards.name: Ramming Cap
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Move into Melee range of a target within Close range and make a Weapons Action Roll against it. On a success, deal Pd8 physical damage. You can then **mark a Hull Point** to make the target mark a Hull Point. **While Available:** You have an extra Weapons Hull Point.

cards.name: Destructive Scan
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal Pd6 tech damage, and you can **mark a Stress** to **Lock** the target. **With Lock:** On a success, it also becomes your **Studied Target**.

cards.name: Dissection Ray
cards.rules: **Forward Facing.** Make a Weapons Action Roll against your **Studied Target**. On a success, deal Pd4+6 tech damage. If it marks 2 or more Hull Points, it marks 1 more. **With Lock:** Deal Pd8+6 instead.

cards.name: Resonant Echo
cards.rules: Make a Weapons Action Roll against a target within Close range, with advantage if it is your **Studied Target**. On a success, you can **mark up to 3 Stress**. Deal 2d8 physical damage, plus 1d8 for each Stress marked. Then you can **spend Hope** to clear Stress, one for one. **With Lock:** The target marks Hull Points as if your ship were one size larger.

cards.name: Critical Point Tracking
cards.rules: **With Lock:** When you succeed on a Weapons Action Roll against your **Studied Target**, add 2d6 to the damage.

cards.name: Manual Inspection
cards.rules: **Spend a Hope** to let a willing ship within Melee range clear a Hull Point.

cards.name: Innervation
cards.rules: Whenever you would gain Hope, you can clear that many Stress instead. **While Available:** You have an extra Stress slot.

cards.name: Slighted Spite
cards.rules: When you or an ally within Close range takes damage from an adversary, you can **spend a Hope** to **Lock** that adversary.

cards.name: Empathic Network
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to create a **Cloud**. When a ship in your **Cloud** would mark Hull Points, you can **mark one of them instead**. If that damage was Severe, gain a Hope.

cards.name: Anticipatory Neurons
cards.rules: You have advantage on rolls to **Lock**. When a roll to **Lock** gives you a Hope, one ally within Close range also gains a Hope. **While Available:** You have an extra Stress slot.

cards.name: Diagnosis Scanner
cards.rules: **Spend any number of Analysis Tokens** to make a Science Action Roll (18), adding the number spent to the roll. On a success, an ally within Very Close range clears a Hull Point and clears a Stress for each token spent.

cards.name: Optimized Routines
cards.rules: **Spend an Analysis Token** and **spend a Hope** to gain advantage on a roll. When you roll with Hope, you can gain an **Analysis Token** instead of the Hope.

cards.name: Warded Hull
cards.rules: When you would mark Hull Points from damage, you can first **spend 2 Analysis Tokens** to reduce the severity by one threshold. **While Available:** You have an extra Stress slot.

cards.name: Opportunistic Analysis
cards.rules: When you deal damage to a ship, you can **spend an Analysis Token** to make it **Vulnerable** until the end of its next spotlight or yours, whichever comes first.

cards.name: Detailed Systems Readout
cards.rules: When you **Lock** a ship with an action roll, gain an **Analysis Token**. If you start a scene with no **Analysis Tokens**, gain one.

cards.name: Synced Arcana
cards.rules: Add the trait you use for Science rolls to your damage thresholds, if it's positive.

cards.name: Charge Extraction
cards.rules: Once during your spotlight, when you make an adversary mark a Stress, you can **spend a Hope** to clear a Stress.

cards.name: Chaos Drive
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to add the GM's current Fear to a non-Weapons Action Roll.

cards.name: Matter Inversion
cards.rules: When you make an action roll with Fear, put an *Inversion Token* on this card (up to 3). **Spend an Inversion Token** to choose the damage type of any damage dealt by or to a ship within Very Close range of you.

cards.name: Electrified Field
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to create a **Cloud**. Attacks made from inside your **Cloud** deal an extra 1d8 damage on a success. The first time an attack from inside the **Cloud** hits an adversary, gain a Hope.

cards.name: Electron Beam
cards.rules: Make a Science Action Roll (13). On a success, you can **spend a Power Token** to let a ship within Close range clear 2 Stress. Once per spotlight, you can **mark a Stress** to gain a **Power Token**.

cards.name: Oscillating Power Supply
cards.rules: Once per spotlight, you can **mark a Stress** to gain 2 **Power Tokens**, or **spend 2 Power Tokens** to clear a Stress. **While Available:** You have an extra Stress slot.

cards.name: Electrified Hull
cards.rules: **Spend a Power Token** to make a willing ship within Melee range *Electrified*. The next time it docks with another ship, that ship marks a Hull Point and a Stress, and *Electrified* ends.

cards.name: Close Range Scanning Battery
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to make a Science Action Roll against a target within Close range. On a success, it is **Locked** and takes Pd4 physical damage.

cards.name: Hull Cannibalization
cards.rules: Once per **Refuel**, **mark a Hull Point** to clear 3 Stress. **While Available:** You have an extra Science Hull Point.

cards.name: Pulse Beacon
cards.rules: **Mark a Hull Point** to deploy a *Pulse Beacon*: a size 1 object with Evasion 15, your damage thresholds and 5 HP. You can move the Beacon to a point within Close range instead of moving your ship. When you deploy or move it, you can make a Science Action Roll against each ship within Close range of the Beacon. Ships you succeed against are **Vulnerable** while within Close range of it, and you can **Lock** one of them.

cards.name: Advanced Targeting
cards.rules: When you **Lock** a ship, you can **mark a Stress** to make it your **Studied Target**. At the start of your spotlight, you can **Lock** your **Studied Target** as a reaction.

cards.name: Sensor Mirage
cards.rules: When an ally within Close range becomes **Locked**, you can make a Science Action Roll against the highest Difficulty among adversaries. On a success, the **Lock** ends, and the roll counts as a success with Hope. On a failure, it counts as a failure with Fear.

cards.name: Phase Alignment
cards.rules: When your **Studied Target** deals tech damage to a ship, that ship can **spend a Hope** to reduce the severity by one threshold.

cards.name: Gravitational Lens Drive
cards.rules: Allies' attacks can pass through your ship. While you have any unmarked Stress, physical and tech attacks you choose that pass within Very Close range of you add 1 to their Proficiency.

cards.name: Quantum Entanglement
cards.rules: Your **Studied Target** doesn't end until you choose, even when the scene ends. You always know the direction of your **Studied Target** and how many unmarked Stress it has, at any distance.

cards.name: Scanning Array
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to create a **Cloud**. At the start of their spotlights, allies can **Lock** any target in your **Cloud** as a reaction. When the **Cloud** dissipates, you can make any ship in it your **Studied Target**.

cards.name: Neural Interface
cards.rules: When you have no Hope and gain any Hope, clear a Stress. **While Available:** You have an extra Stress slot.

cards.name: Corrosive Slime
cards.rules: Once per spotlight, when you **make contact** with a ship, you can mark a Stress to lower its Major threshold by 2 and its Severe threshold by 4 for the rest of the scene.

cards.name: Selective Shedding
cards.rules: When you **make contact** with a ship, you can **spend a Hope** to slow it: until the end of its next spotlight, it can only move to a point within Very Close range. In a **Chase**, it moves back one band instead.

cards.name: Arcanic Connection
cards.rules: Once per **Refuel**, the pilot can cast one of their spells through your ship. Make an Engineering Action Roll in place of the Spellcast Roll. The spell can affect ships your size or smaller as it would affect adversaries, at ship ranges.

cards.name: Eldritch Breeze
cards.rules: Make an Engineering Action Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, it is temporarily caught in *Unfair Winds*. When it moves, you can **spend a Hope** or an **Analysis Token** to push it to a point within Very Close range of where it stopped. If you don't, *Unfair Winds* ends.

cards.name: Rift Generator
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to make an Engineering Action Roll (13). On a success, teleport to a point within Very Far range. For each ally within Very Close range you bring with you, **mark another Stress or 2 Hull Points**.

cards.name: Pocket Dimension
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to make an Engineering Action Roll (16). On a success, you open a pocket dimension holding an abandoned space station. It lasts long enough for one **Refuel**, and a **Refuel** there clears half as much (round down). Characters can rest there undisturbed. Messages can pass in or out only if you allow it.

cards.name: Boarding Glyph
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to make an Engineering Action Roll against a ship within Very Close range (12 if it is willing). On a success, mark it with a *Boarding Glyph* and choose a place on your ship. Creatures you allow can travel between that place and a matching place on the marked ship (bridge to bridge, cargo bay to cargo bay). When a creature you forbid tries, make an Engineering Reaction Roll against it; on a success, it takes Pd8 magic damage and doesn't cross. The Glyph lasts while your ship has a pilot, your Engineering system isn't **Breached**, and the marked ship is within Far range.

cards.name: Cloaking Field
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to become *Cloaked* until you make a Weapons or Transport Action Roll. While *Cloaked*, adversaries can't target you, and your first attack has advantage. Once per adversary spotlight, the GM can spend a Fear to reveal you; you can **spend a Hope** to stay *Cloaked*.

cards.name: Graviton Mine
cards.rules: Make an Engineering Action Roll (15). On a success, you can **mark a Stress** and **mark a Hull Point** to place a *Graviton Mine* at a point within Close range. Other ships within Close range of the Mine are temporarily **Restrained**. Each of them that starts its spotlight within Close range of the Mine makes a Transport Reaction Roll (10 + the GM's current Fear): on a failure, it is pulled to the Mine; on a success, it is no longer **Restrained**. At the start of your next spotlight, every ship at the Mine takes Pd10+4 physical damage, ignoring size, and the Mine and its **Restrained** condition end.

cards.name: Void Attuned
cards.rules: While you have 4 or more Void cards in your loadout, you have resistance to magic damage, and you clear a Stress whenever you take magic damage.

cards.name: Scrap Hound
cards.rules: Once per **Refuel**, when an adversary ship is destroyed, you can clear Hull Points equal to 1d4 + its size.

cards.name: Veil of Night
cards.rules: Make an Engineering Action Roll (13) to create a *Veil of Night*: a flat plane through the battlefield, reaching Very Far range in every direction. When a ship passes through it, you can **mark a Stress** or **spend an Analysis Token** to make that ship mark a Hull Point. Communications, light, sensing, tech damage and magic damage can't pass through the Veil. You can dismiss it at the end of any spotlight; it ends with the scene.

cards.name: Siphon Array
cards.rules: When a ship within Very Close range marks a Stress, you can **spend a Hope** to gain 2 **Power Tokens**. If you start a scene with no **Power Tokens**, gain 2.

cards.name: Position Scrambler
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to put 3 *Scrambler Tokens* on this card. When an adversary attacks you, you can **spend a Scrambler Token** or a **Power Token** to give the attack disadvantage.

cards.name: Pulsar Mine
cards.rules: Make an Engineering Action Roll (15). On a success, you can **mark a Stress** and **mark a Hull Point** to place a *Pulsar Mine* at a point within Close range. Other ships within Close range of it take Pd6 tech damage. The Mine is removed at the start of your next spotlight. If you have a card that creates a **Cloud**, you can create that **Cloud** at the Mine's location without paying its cost.

cards.name: Energy Drain
cards.rules: Make an Engineering Action Roll against a ship within Very Close range. On a success, it marks a Stress and you clear a Stress.

cards.name: Overload Barrage
cards.rules: **Mark a Stress** to make an Engineering Action Roll against a ship within Close range. On a success, it is *Overloaded* until it next attacks or the scene ends. When an *Overloaded* ship attacks, the attack has disadvantage and the ship takes Pd6 tech damage.

cards.name: Shrapnel Mine
cards.rules: Make an Engineering Action Roll (15). On a success, you can **mark a Stress** and **mark a Hull Point** to put a *Shrapnel Mine Token* on this card. When an adversary within Close range of you moves, you can **spend the token** to deal Pd12+5 physical damage to it. At the start of any later spotlight, you can **discard the token** to clear a Stress and a Hull Point.

cards.name: Docking Winch
cards.rules: You have advantage on rolls to dock. You can give rolls to undock from your ship disadvantage.

cards.name: Counterfire
cards.rules: This card holds 2 **Reload Tokens**. When an adversary attacks you, before damage is rolled, you can **spend any number of Reload Tokens** as a reaction. Each token removes one damage die from the attack, to a minimum of 1 die.

cards.name: Undercoat
cards.rules: At the start of your spotlight, add the number of your marked Hull Points to your damage thresholds until your next spotlight.

cards.name: Lightweight Frame
cards.rules: You have +2 Evasion for each of your **Breached** systems.

cards.name: Orbiting Plate
cards.rules: **Mark a Hull Point** to create an *Orbiting Plate*. When an attack roll beats your Evasion by less than 5, you can **destroy the Plate** to take no damage from it. During your spotlight, you can **destroy the Plate** to clear a Hull Point instead.

cards.name: Projection Field
cards.rules: When you or allies you choose make an action roll against your **Studied Target**, treat it as one range closer.

cards.name: Parallax Protocol
cards.rules: When an adversary attacks you, you can **mark a Stress** to gain +3 Evasion against that attack. If the attacker is your **Studied Target**, you can then clear a Stress.

cards.name: Ultraviolet Imaging
cards.rules: **Spend a Hope** to make an Engineering Action Roll against a target within Very Far range. On a success, it is *Highlighted* until it leaves Very Far range or you use this card on another target. A *Highlighted* ship is **Vulnerable** and can't become **Hidden** or *Cloaked* unless something physically blocks it. If you rolled with Hope, you can also make it your **Studied Target**.

options.name: Gain a Stress Slot or a Hull Point
Gain +1 Evasion or a Hull Point

compartments.name: Personal Armory
compartments.rules: Holds up to 4 weapons, conveniently placed where you need them.

compartments.name: Stim Lab
compartments.rules: Each rest, roll 1d30 on the Stims list and gain that consumable.

compartments.name: Stasis Chamber
compartments.rules: When you rest in your ship and **Tend Wounds**, you always tend all wounds.

compartments.name: Meditation Room
compartments.rules: When you rest in your ship and **Clear Stress**, you always clear all Stress.

compartments.name: Suit Locker
compartments.rules: Keep up to 2 spare suits of armor on board. Their marked slots are not cleared automatically, but they can be swapped out in a few minutes. During a rest, clear only one suit; during a refit, clear all.

compartments.name: War Room
compartments.rules: When you **Prepare**, you always gain 2 Hope. Each other person in your party gains a Hope each rest if they do not Prepare.

compartments.name: Gym
compartments.rules: When you rest in your ship, gain a +1 to a physical trait until your next rest.

compartments.name: Library
compartments.rules: When you rest in your ship, gain a +1 to a mental trait until your next rest.
